versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "a-stock-quant-diag" skill.
- Provides a comprehensive methodology for quantitative diagnosis of A-shares.
- Integrates data from akshare and baostock covering technical, valuation, fund position, institutional holding, and peer comparison dimensions.
- Outputs include 5-factor scoring, three-level target price calculation, and actionable buy/sell recommendations.
- Includes function quick reference and real-world validation examples.
- Applicable to all main boards, ChiNext, and STAR Market stocks.
